summary: CNL Strategic Residential Credit filed an 8-K reporting that its indirect wholly-owned financing subsidiary, RCRED Craftsman Administrator, LLC, as seller, amended and restated its Master Repurchase Agreement with Goldman Sachs Bank USA as buyer and repo agent. The November 3, 2026 amendment revises the income payment waterfall by eliminating a requirement for certain payments to reduce the outstanding purchase price, with related changes. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or ownership change is involved; this is a routine warehouse/repo facility modification covered under Items 1.01 and 2.03, with the agreement filed as Exhibit 10.1. Watch facility covenants and margin terms.
